source_title: Embassy of India Marketing Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
The Embassy of India in Astana, Kazakhstan, is hiring one Marketing Assistant for a full-time post that becomes vacant from 23 November 2026. Your CV and a covering letter in English must reach the Embassy by 14 November 2026. You can send them by post or by email. You must be 21 to 35 years old, speak and write English, Russian and Kazakh fluently, and hold the papers you need to work for a foreign diplomatic mission in Kazakhstan.
Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview
The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.
The Embassy of India in Astana is India's diplomatic mission in Kazakhstan. Its Administration Division, which handles this recruitment, is on the 10th Floor, 62 A, Kosmonavtov, Astana. The Marketing Assistant will work on the Embassy's trade and commercial work, including trade between India and Kazakhstan.
Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
The Embassy will also pay an annual bonus of one month's salary after you complete one year of service.
Working with local trade organisations, associations and government Ministries on events for trade promotion, tourism, business conferences and similar work
Writing reports on the Embassy's commercial events
Collecting and analysing statistics on trade between India and Kazakhstan
Replying to trade and commercial questions from Indian and Kazakh traders
Translating and interpreting official documents
Helping official delegations during their visits to Astana
Any other suitable duties the Embassy gives
Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Eligibility 2026
Fluency (both oral and written) in English, Russian and Kazakh
Good computer skills, including word processing, Excel, PowerPoint, Canva and email
Good administrative, organisational and time management abilities
Willingness to learn and develop new skills
Specialisation in Marketing or Business Administration
3 to 5 years of previous experience in similar work
Only candidates who hold a Local Work Permit, Resident Visa or similar document will be considered. The document must comply with local rules for working in foreign diplomatic missions.
See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.
This is a full-time job. It becomes a permanent position once you complete probation.
The place of work is the Embassy of India, Astana.
You get 21 days of annual leave after completing one year of service.
How to Apply for Embassy of India Astana Marketing Assistant Recruitment 2026
Write a CV and a covering letter, both in English.
Send them by post to: Administration Division, Embassy of India, 10th Floor, 62 A, Kosmonavtov, Astana, Kazakhstan.
Make sure your application reaches the Embassy by 14 November 2026.
Documents to send: your CV and a covering letter in English.
